limitations: Historical WAV equality remains fingerprint-based; the absent historical WAVs were not recreated or relabeled as captured originals.
Compiled executables, shared/static SDK and core libraries, objects, build trees, caches and unrelated files are deliberately excluded; this is not a self-contained executable replay environment.
Paths in original source and logs remain verbatim. The manifest maps safe repository-relative original paths to content blobs; no archive extraction is needed for verification.
An archive digest binds the retained bytes, not the truth of the original experiment or a reproducible build. Existing report scope, baseline provenance, timing and DAW limitations remain in force.
